complexity.notes: Correct and O(1) space, but each `in` check on a list is a full scan, making this quadratic. An O(n)-time, O(1)-space solution exists using ||the arithmetic-series sum n(n+1)/2 minus sum(nums), or XOR-ing all indices and values||; an O(n)-time alternative with O(n) space uses ||a set of the values for O(1) membership checks||.
complexity.summary: For each candidate value from 0 to n, linearly scans the list with `in` until the absent one is found.
